name: electron-builder.yml
html:
# electron-builder config — per-OS installers for the desktop wrapper.
# Run from repo root: yarn desktop:build (builds dist/ first).
appId: com.luiskr.site
productName: luiskr.com
copyright: Luis Kr

directories:
  app: .
  output: ../release

files:
  - main.mjs
  - package.json
  # Window/taskbar icon — loaded by BrowserWindow at runtime.
  - icon.png
  # The wrapper is pure node builtins + electron — the workspace's prod
  # deps (firebase/three/mermaid…) must not ship inside the asar.
  - '!node_modules/**'

# The production build ships inside the app's resources — main.mjs serves
# it over an ephemeral localhost port. Filter keeps only the tiers a fixed
# modern Chromium can pick: esnext (feature-detected) + es2026 (the
# modulepreload/default tier). .br/.gz sidecars are deployment artifacts —
# the internal server does no encoding negotiation.
extraResources:
  - from: ../dist
    to: dist
    filter:
      - '**/*'
      - '!v/**'
      - 'v/esnext/**'
      - 'v/es2026/**'
      - '!**/*.br'
      - '!**/*.gz'

asar: true

mac:
  category: public.app-category.productivity
  target: dmg

win:
  target: nsis
  icon: icon.ico

nsis:
  oneClick: false
  allowToChangeInstallationDirectory: true
  perMachine: false
  installerIcon: icon.ico
  uninstallerIcon: icon.ico

linux:
  category: Utility
  target: AppImage
  icon: icon.png
